newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices mixed, new arrivals seen up.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices mixed, new arrivals seen up.

text.p: Indian Gujarat cotton recovered from recent losses on Tuesday while Punjab cotton remained steady at a reduced level, dealers said.
In spot deals Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) rose to 19,000/19,700 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) from 18,600/19,500. Punjab cotton was steady on low activity.
"Farmers in the Punjab region are now bringing limited quantities to the market ahead of the Diwali festival but new crop arrivals will pick up after Diwali," he said.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 825/850 rupees while Punjab saw-ginned was steady at 1,580/1,700.
